text:
I have type 2 diabetes and was on Mounjaro for two years. I stopped taking it a few months ago because I felt so fatigued that I could barely function. My diet didn’t change much—I just ate less—but I had almost no energy, even for a simple walk. A friend had to come over to help me clean because I was so exhausted.

On top of that, I started dreading the injections because they made me feel like I was going to throw up, and the nausea lasted for three days. It really impacted my quality of life. Over two years, I lost a total of 22 pounds while on the 5 mg dose. Every time I tried increasing it, I experienced severe stomach pain and almost ended up in the hospital.

Since stopping Mounjaro, I’ve been constantly sick. I had a severe two-week illness with nonstop vomiting, followed by two sinus infections that turned into bronchitis—one in February and now again in March. I live in Florida and rarely get sick, so this is really unusual for me. I’m not sure if my body is trying to cleanse itself or if Mounjaro may have affected my immune system.
